description:
A Java project 'CommandPatternApp' is open in Eclipse. The file src/com/example/commands/CommandSystem.java contains 7 type definitions that should each be in their own file:

1. Command (interface)
2. UndoableCommand (interface extending Command)
3. TextDocument (class)
4. InsertTextCommand (class implementing UndoableCommand)
5. DeleteTextCommand (class implementing UndoableCommand)
6. MacroCommand (class implementing Command)
7. CommandInvoker (class)

Using Eclipse's refactoring tools (e.g., Refactor > Move Type to New File), extract each type from CommandSystem.java into its own .java file in the same package (com.example.commands). After extraction, CommandSystem.java should be deleted or contain at most one type.

The project must compile with zero errors after all types are extracted. The existing Main.java class uses all these types, so imports must be correct.

After completing all extractions, run Main.java and save its console output to /home/ga/refactored_output.txt (Right-click Main.java > Run As > Java Application, then copy the console output to the file).
